text:
maya: Quick async sync — I'm planning to flip precision_gating_v2 for model-omega on prod routes that need low latency. Planning small audience, but want eyes on guardrails before I schedule the flip. TL;DR: int8 for short-response routes, fallback to fp16, deadman timer + metric checks.

sam: Sounds good. Can you post the exact flag payload you'll use and the target audience slice? want to check overlap with recent A/B tests.

maya: Yup, example config I'm proposing:
```json
{
  "flag": "precision_gating_v2",
  "model": "model-omega",
  "routes": ["text-gen-latency", "short-response"],
  "audience_pct": 3,
  "precision": "int8",
  "fallback": "fp16",
  "deadman_sec": 300,
  "observability_tags": ["quant-rollout", "low-latency"]
}
```

jordan: 3% is fine. Can we gate by region as well? don't want early traffic from EU3 because of our quant kernel mismatch on the older nodes.

maya: Good catch — will add region_allowlist: [us-west-2, us-east-1] to the payload.

lee: Add a circuit-breaker on token-error-rate and a latency tail check. Suggested thresholds: token_error_rate > 0.5% over 5m OR p99 latency degrade > 15% vs baseline -> auto-disable flag.

anika: Also recommend enabling logging sampling at 100% for the first hour so we can inspect failure modes on short responses. Then drop to 1%.

maya: Ok plan updated. I'll run a staged flip: 0.5% -> 1% -> 3% over 30m windows with health checks in between. Deadman timer still 5m after each incremental step (so if we forget to roll back, it self-reverts).

sam: Please add the rollout plan to the PR description and tag me for a quick review. also include the alert runbook link.

maya: PR created: https://git.internal/fw/PR/4821 — description has config + observability dashboard links. Tagging @sam @jordan for review.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Flag precision_gating_v2 scheduled for 2026-06-02T18:30Z by maya. Instance: prod. Audience schedule: [0.5%, 1%, 3%]. Monitoring hooks attached: /dashboards/omega-quant-rollout, /alerts/omega-quant-safety.

jordan: Quick code-review nit: payload uses "deadman_sec": 300 but our flags infra expects "deadman_ms". Maya, change that before the flip or the self-revert won't work.

maya: thanks — fixed and pushed. Also added region_allowlist and the circuit-breaker thresholds Lee suggested.

lee: One more: can we add a model-variant fallback mapping just if int8 path triggers a runtime kernel fallback (rare but possible)? sample mapping: int8 -> fp16 -> cpu-fallback.

maya: Added mapping. PR updated. I'll wait for @sam review and then schedule the flip during the low-traffic window tomorrow morning.

sam: Reviewed and approved. Please run the smoke: `curl -sS https://staging.api/omega/short -H \"X-Test-Audience: 0.5\" | jq .latency` and confirm p95/p99 are within expected.

maya: Will run smoke and post results here after the first 0.5% flip.

anika: FYI, I'll be watching logs for hallucination regressions (sampling flagged prompts). If we see a surge, we'll pause immediately. :eyes:

ops-bot: alert: health-checks passed at 1972003600 for audience 0.5%. p95 latency change: +3%, token_error_rate: 0.12%. No action.

maya: First step looks good. moving to 1% in 10m.

sam: :thumbsup: go for it. If anything odd, hit the rollback button `./scripts/flag-rollback precision_gating_v2` and ping #eng-oncall.

maya: Will do. tagging this thread for audit. Anyone object to schedule or thresholds?

jordan: none from me.

lee: good to go.

anika: good. monitoring.

maya: Thanks all — I'll post a short postmortem if we see any anomalies, otherwise I'll close the PR after 24h.
